unit.why: A hagiographic biographical note on R. Joseph di Trani (Mahari"t), taken from the Hida's Shem ha-Gedolim, with a short anecdote about wealthy brothers who took him in and supported him so he could study.
unit.boundary_note: Opening words continue the heading 'מענין הרב מהרי״ט' at the end of the previous division.

stories.start_quote: מהר״ר יוסף מטראני בן פורת להרב המבי״ט
stories.end_quote: (שה״ג להג׳ חיד״א מער' י׳ אות קלו)
stories.summary_en: Biography and praise of R. Joseph di Trani: his studies in Safed and Egypt, his rabbinate in Constantinople and his humility. Wealthy brothers took him into their home as a full partner in their property so he could study Torah undisturbed, as Rabbi did with R. Hiyya.

tags.why: Praise of a pre-Hasidic rabbinic authority, copied from Shem ha-Gedolim
